description: k8s finalize-result 400 loop from empty tracker files: ml prune leaves zero-byte .mulch/expertise/*.jsonl, collectMulchDelta ships them verbatim (mergedBody: ''), validateArtifactDelta's reqString rejects '', the pod retries 5x and exits 75, and the run reaps finalize_unposted with its PUSHED branch stranded on origin. Salvage (warren-cd3b) never fires because the push succeeded. Diagnosis path: pod log tail shows 'result POST attempt n/5 got HTTP 400' + 'pushed=true'; server log shows the ValidationError stack at finalize-wire.ts validateArtifactDelta.
resolution: Validator accepts empty mergedBody via reqStringAllowEmpty (PR #984); stranded work recovered by opening the PR manually from the surviving warren/run_<id> branch (PR #983).

description: commitsAhead used plain rev-list <base>..HEAD, so a follow-up run that merged upstream into its PR branch reported every merged-in upstream commit (run_gevytzavaht0: 3278 for a 3-commit fix).
resolution: Added --first-parent to the rev-list count in both local and k8s finalizers (warren-a8cc, PR #1189). Test fakes match on args[0], so only exact-args assertions needed updating.

description: POST /runs/:id/cancel on a K8s run was classified as failed/sandbox_run_lost (later provider_error) rather than cancelled, and infra-lost retry auto-redispatched the cancelled run (run_2g53bxq8m2fh -> run_0v5m7qq5t6ys, retryOf set), doubling a dispatch.
resolution: Filed as a follow-up seed; cancel must be terminal and never retryable. Until fixed, cancel the retry child too.

title: Auto-merge arming policy is fail-closed on every unreadable input
rationale: The arm decision must never widen on an input it could not fully evaluate (docs/design/forge-auto-merge.md sections 3-4, warren-7b2f lesson). Empty diff means the source was unreliable; an unparseable protectedPaths glob protects everything instead of nothing; and the policy itself always resolves from the base ref because the agent authors the run branch.

name: auto-merge-trusted-remote-snapshot
description: Auto-merge policy must not trust shared worktree refs or Git config: LocalProvider exposes the common Git directory writable in both bwrap and seatbelt. Fetch the configured remote base and pushed head into a fresh bare repository beside the host clone, pin commit SHAs, and fail closed without local-ref fallback. Avoid system temp for this snapshot because seatbelt grants agents writes there.

title: Provider-error runs with pushed commits still get a PR
rationale: A provider error after a gate-green commit+push leaves reviewable work stranded on origin (run_03wb2b8crbz6 needed a hand-opened PR, #1206); a branch with real commits ahead is not bookkeeping, so pr_open is the one success-pipeline step unlocked for it — seed close, plan-run advance, and preview stay gated on true success (GitHub #1238).
